verdict.rationale: Weave documents ready-made integrations where calling `weave.init()` is enough to auto-trace the OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, and Google ADK. It also auto-records calls and costs for supported provider integrations including OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere, and Mistral, and offers an OTel-compatible path for traces from other popular SDKs. missing for 10: no evidence of named LangChain or Vercel AI SDK integrations, no full integration catalog in the pack, no independent or hands-on corroboration.
